Lemma
[Parametrization of maps near the identity] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0284, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0285 1. ch34:34.9\group Harmonic Maps on Spheres

For $n\ge 2$, a neighborhood of $(\operatorname {id}_{S^n},0)$ in \[ \operatorname {Isom}(S^n) imes \operatorname {KV}(S^n)_{2,\alpha }^{\perp } \] is mapped diffeomorphically onto a neighborhood of the identity in $C^{2,\alpha }(S^n,S^n)$ by $\Phi (f,\sigma )(x)=\exp _{f(x)}(\sigma _{f(x)})$. When $n=2$, the analogous statement holds with conformal diffeomorphisms and conformal Killing fields.
Proof

\sketch At $(\operatorname {id},0)$, the derivative is $( au , u )\mapsto au + u $. The Killing fields and their $L^2$-orthogonal complement form the whole section space, so this derivative is an isomorphism. The inverse function theorem proves the first assertion. The identical argument with conformal Killing fields proves the second.

□
